observations: Two photos show a car transmission/gearbox assembly laid on the ground.
Photo 0 shows the gearbox with the bellhousing area and a large circular front component (likely torque converter/flexplate side) and multiple hoses/wiring harnesses attached.
Photo 1 shows the top/side of the gearbox with many hydraulic lines, sensors/connectors, and a long metal casing.
No clear brand badge, model number, or plate is readable in either photo.

identity.kind: automatic gearbox/transmission assembly (exact make/model not readable)

claims.claim: Direct tokunbo Japan highest grade Rogue and Altima gearbox
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photos do not show a readable vehicle fitment label, part number, or brand/model identification to confirm Nissan Rogue/Altima or 'Japan tokunbo' status.

risks.risk: Wrong fitment (Rogue vs Altima vs other Nissan models/years) or wrong transmission type (CVT vs automatic) leading to incompatibility.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the gearbox identification plate/label and/or stamped part number (and the transmission type) plus the vehicle VIN/engine code it was removed from.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: incompatible/unknown fitment and treated as not guaranteed to work.

risks.risk: Condition unknown: may be damaged internally (slipping, no engagement) even if it looks intact externally.
risks.proof: Video of the gearbox being tested in a running donor vehicle (engage P/R, drive) or a bench test report with fault codes cleared.

risks.risk: Missing parts or incomplete harness/solenoids (photos show wiring/lines but cannot confirm completeness).
risks.proof: Photo checklist: all connectors, sensors, solenoids, cooler lines, and any included torque converter/valve body components laid out and counted.

risks.risk: Fluid contamination/leaks (ground placement and external wetness may indicate leaks; cannot confirm).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of seals/gaskets and a leak test after filling with correct fluid; show any wet spots around casing seams.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: may leak/needs reseal.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the gearbox identification plate/label and any stamped part number (and transmission type).
Photo of the torque converter/flexplate side showing whether the torque converter is included (if applicable).
Video proof of installation/test: engage gears (P/R/D) and show no warning lights/fault codes.
Provide the donor vehicle details (year, model, engine code) or VIN of the vehicle it was removed from.
response.reason: The photos show a transmission assembly but do not provide readable identification to confirm the claimed Nissan Rogue/Altima fitment or condition. Without part number/fitment proof and a test, a worst-case price cannot be confidently set.
